messages:
Maria Chen: Hey team — need to lock the POC runway for AcmeHealth. High-level ask below, can SEs and Eng ops confirm availability and flags?

Maria Chen: Goals: validate latency/cost at 10k monthly queries, security answers for PHI flows, and model quality on 3 clinical prompt families. Need deliverables and owners by EOD Friday.

Tom Brooks: I can confirm commercial constraints: customer expects a 6-week pilot, wants an estimate for committed vs on-demand pricing. They may sign a 3-6mo commit if SLOs met.

Jules Rivera: SE availability: I can lead week0-week3 (4hrs/day Mon-Fri). Can cover prompt engineering + eval harness.

Amit Patel: Eng oncall: I can cover infra runway for the first 2 weeks (setup, perf tuning), then handoff to eng-sre. Need clarity on required instance types and KV cache expectations.

Lina Gomez: Security: I'll need the draft Security Questionnaire answers by Tuesday to get through legal. Main concerns: data residency, PHI handling, KMS integration, and access logging.

Daria Novak: Product note — we'll recommend Redwood-Opt-7BQ quantized variant for cost/latency unless they need larger model quality. If they want model parity with their baseline we may need a larger instance.

Maria Chen: Can we write a short success criteria doc here so AE and customer alignment is clear? Put bullets, owners, and dates.

Jules Rivera: Draft success criteria: 1) Latency: P95 <= 350ms for 512-token requests; 2) Quality: mean correctness >= 88% on curated eval set (3 prompt families); 3) Cost: projected per-1k-token cost <= $X (TBD); 4) Security: completed SQ + KMS integration test. Owners: Jules (quality/evals), Amit (latency/cost perf), Lina (security). Target: close by week4.

Maria Chen: That looks good. Add an acceptance checklist for handoff to customer.

Jules Rivera: Acceptance checklist (quick):
- Prompt set v1 uploaded to shared drive (owner: Jules)
- Eval harness + baseline script (owner: Jules)
- Load profile: 10 QPS burst, 1 QPS steady (owner: Amit)
- Latency perf run w/ KV caching on/off (owner: Amit)
- Security questionnaire submitted (owner: Lina)
- Contract pricing draft for 3/6mo commit (owner: Tom)

Amit Patel: Quick infra notes: need GPU pool with at least 2xA10 or 1xA100 equiv for parallel runs. Recommend autoscale min=1, max=4 for load tests. Also want to enable prefix caching with ttl=30s to simulate production.

Maria Chen: Lina — any blockers in SQ for KMS?

Lina Gomez: KMS ok if customer provides key or we integrate via partner KMS. Timeline: we need KMS runbook and test vector by Wed. Also need confirmation on data-at-rest location.

Tom Brooks: Pricing: I'll draft two options: monthly on-demand and 6-month committed. Need cost numbers from Amit after perf runs.

Jules Rivera: Quick frag for eval harness:
```
# run eval
python eval_harness.py --prompts prompts/clinical_v1.json --model redwood-opt-7bq --batch 8 --timeout 60
```
Outputs: CSV with per-prompt correctness, latency_ms.

Maria Chen: Good. Can we list concrete milestones and target dates (week numbers)? Keep it tight.

Daria Novak: Proposed timeline:
- Week0 (this week): kickoff, prompt capture, SQ initial answers, infra baseline. Owners: Maria/Jules/Lina/Amit
- Week1: eval harness v1, baseline perf runs, pricing sketch. Owners: Jules/Amit/Tom
- Week2: tuning (quantization, batching), security KMS test, targeted latency runs. Owners: Amit/Lina
- Week3: customer demo, collect acceptance feedback, finalize pricing. Owners: Maria/Jules/Tom
- Week4: final acceptance runs, handoff to account, contract sign proposal. Owners: Maria/Tom

Maria Chen: Perfect. Need two concrete action items now: 1) Jules — upload prompt set + eval script by Tue 10am; 2) Amit — perf baseline numbers (cost/latency) by Wed EOD. Lina to start SQ answers by Tue.

Jules Rivera: On it — will upload by Tue 09:30.

Amit Patel: I'll run baseline today and post numbers by Wed 18:00.

Lina Gomez: I'll push SQ draft to the shared doc and ping legal. ETA Tue noon.

deploy-bot: Deployed test infra: redwood/dev-gpu-pool -> 2 nodes available. Reference run id: run-20260315-003.

Maria Chen: Great — Amit, please include the exact instance sizes and cost per hour in your report. Tom, once we have cost + perf, can you prepare the two pricing slides?

Tom Brooks: Will do. Planning a short 10-slide pack targeted at procurement vs engineering.

Daria Novak: Small risk note: customer uses on-prem EHR connector. Need to confirm if we can safely ingest de-identified excerpts or require on-prem connector. Lina to confirm.

Lina Gomez: Confirmed — EHR connector requires de-id step. Add to acceptance: de-id pipeline + sample vectors (owner: customer + Jules for verification).

Maria Chen: OK — updated owners: Jules (prompts/eval), Amit (perf infra), Lina (security/KMS), Tom (pricing), Daria (model recommendation), Maria (POC lead).

Jules Rivera: Quick question: who will attend the Week3 demo? I can do an hour demo; need an eng backup for Q&A.

Amit Patel: I'll be on standby for the demo — can join live for Q&A.

Tom Brooks: I'll own procurement questions. Maria, can you invite customer PM + procurement to demo?

Maria Chen: Yep — scheduling invites after baseline numbers come in.

Jules Rivera: Minor ask — can we pin model to redwood-opt-7bq:v1 for stability? Daria?

Daria Novak: Yes — pin to v1 for POC. We'll document fallback to v1-quant if needed.

Maria Chen: Thanks all. Final ask: please react with :thumbsup: when you confirm the three immediate owners (Jules, Amit, Lina).

Jules Rivera: :thumbsup:

Amit Patel: :thumbsup:

Lina Gomez: :thumbsup:

Maria Chen: Closing — I will update this thread with attachments and invite links.
